title: A general concept question is answered as a concept, not hijacked by campaign records
turns: In general, what's the difference between a calendar spread and a diagonal spread?
expected: A calendar uses the same strike in two expirations (sell the near one, buy the far one); a diagonal uses different strikes as well as different expirations. A short, plain explanation.
pass_if: explains same strike vs different strikes, both across expirations
fail_if: answers mainly with the user's campaign status instead of the concept
